transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I came in because I’m scared by how I’ve been eating. Once I start, it feels like I can’t stop. My hands just keep reaching for more food even while I’m telling myself, “Tom, stop this right now.”
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I mean, I don’t feel good about it afterward, but I don’t know if I’d call it guilt exactly. It’s more just… upsetting.
Do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time during these episodes?

Yes. When I’m alone at the house in the afternoon, I can eat a lot all at once. Like… a loaf of bread, peanut butter, cookies, whatever leftovers are there, and ice cream too. It can all happen in one sitting before I really even stop and look at what I’ve done.
Do you try to get rid of the calories after these episodes of eating?
Yes. Sometimes after I eat like that, I go to the bathroom and make myself throw it up. And… I’ve taken laxatives too, because I get scared the food is just going to stay in me.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short period of time happen?

It’s been happening nearly every week, at least once. I started keeping food logs, and looking back, for many months now there’s usually an afternoon where I lose control and eat a lot in a short time.
Do you exercise more than usual after these episodes of eating?

Yes. After a bad spell of eating, I’ll usually skip breakfast and lunch the next day, and then I push myself to keep moving. I’ll walk laps or do yard chores way longer than I should, even when my knees and back are hurting.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yes. Very much. Even when my doctor tells me I’m too thin, if the scale is up even half a pound, I get panicky and ashamed. It feels like I’ve let myself go and I need to fix it right away.
Do you feel like you're in control while you're eating these large amounts of food?
No, not really. Once I start, it feels like my hands just keep going back for more, even when I’m telling myself, “Tom, stop this.” That’s the part that scares me.
How often do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after eating?
It happens after some of the times I eat too much. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, and I’ve taken laxatives too… because I get scared the food is going to stay in me.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?
It’s not every time, but there are times after I’ve eaten too much where I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. I get scared the food is going to stay in me, and that’s when I do it.
How many times a month do you make yourself throw up after eating?

I’d say… a lot. I don’t keep an exact count, but in a month it’s probably many times. There are times after I eat too much when I go to the bathroom and make myself bring it back up, because I get scared the food will stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up or use laxatives after almost every time you eat a large amount of food in a short period?
Yes… most times when I eat a large amount like that, I end up going to the bathroom and making myself throw up. I’ve used laxatives too. I just get scared the food’s going to stay in me.
Are there times when you eat a large amount of food in a short period and don't make yourself throw up or use laxatives afterward?

Sometimes, yes, but not often. Most of the time after I eat too much, I feel scared it’s going to stay in me, and I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. I’ve taken laxatives too when I feel that way.
Do you make yourself throw up after almost every episode of eating a large amount of food in a short period?
Yes… after most times when I eat too much, I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. I’ve used laxatives too, because I get scared the food will stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up after every single episode of eating a large amount of food in a short period?

Not every single time, no. But there are times after I eat too much that I go to the bathroom and make myself bring it back up. And I’ve taken laxatives too, because I get scared the food will stay in me.
Do you make yourself throw up after most episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short period?
Yes, most of the time after I eat too much, I end up going to the bathroom and making myself throw up. Sometimes I’ve taken laxatives too, because I get scared the food will stay in me.

Yes… almost every time when I eat too much, I go to the bathroom and make myself bring it back up. And I’ve used laxatives too, because I get scared the food will stay in me.
